component.name: Realer Xpad
component.summary: Sticky notes with Markdown and drawing

description.p: Quick little notes that stick to your desktop. Realer Xpad renders Markdown as you type, turns task lists into clickable checkboxes and lets you draw on any note with a pen, highlighter and eraser.

ul.li: Live Markdown with a clean read view
Drawing with stylus pressure and undo
Seven note colours with light and dark variants
Wayland-native, with Hyprland integration for floating and pinning notes

screenshot.caption: Notes in dark mode next to the notes manager
